result.title: Weave Forcing: Compositional Memory Routing for Interactive Long Video Generation
result.summary: Recent advances in autoregressive video generation have improved temporal consistency over extended durations, yet interactive storytelling requires more than continuous scene extension: a new shot may combine characters and backgrounds from different historical shots. Whole prompt retrieval can overlook the distinct reference needs of individual components, while directly combining all historical memories may introduce unrelated visual content. To address these problems, we present Weave Forcing, a training-free framework for compositional memory reuse in interactive long video generation. First, we use an LLM for semantic slot routing to decompose user prompts into character and background descriptions and explicitly select suitable historical references for each component. To isolate the required content, masked memory weaving uses contrasting attention maps conditioned on semantic slots to construct refined semantic masks, selectively exposing relevant tokens from compressed historical KV memories to guide the generation of the current shot. We further introduce coverage adaptive RoPE to adjust temporal offsets and memory retention according to no, partial, or full reference coverage, addressing visual artifacts observed when incomplete historical references are positioned close to the current generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Weave Forcing improves cross-shot subject and background consistency while maintaining competitive visual quality and text alignment.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练的 Weave Forcing 框架，用于交互式长视频生成中的组合式记忆复用：用 LLM 将提示分解为角色与背景语义槽并路由历史参考，再以对比注意力构造语义掩码、选择性暴露压缩 KV 记忆中的相关 token，并用覆盖自适应 RoPE 调整时间偏移与记忆保留。
AI.relevance_reason: 任务是视频生成，但其中的「按语义槽筛选历史 KV 记忆、只暴露相关 token」与 LVR 关注的视觉证据筛选、记忆缓存结构对内部状态的影响可能有概念联系，可供核查其掩码选择机制能否迁移为多模态推理中的证据路由。
